raw.query: SELECT v.run_id, r.arrival_speedup, r.tp, MAX(CASE WHEN v.sla_metric='ttft' THEN v.p99_ms END) AS p99_ttft_ms FROM v_pool_latency v JOIN runs r ON v.run_id=r.run_id AND r.is_current WHERE v.is_current AND v.experiment='g3_32b' AND v.pool='language' AND v.window_name='head2k' AND (v.run_id LIKE '%235b_tp8%' OR v.run_id LIKE '%8b_tp2%') GROUP BY v.run_id, r.arrival_speedup, r.tp ORDER BY r.tp, r.arrival_speedup
raw.observed: 235B-TP8 knee [2.45,2.71] speedup (680.8→1556.9ms p99 TTFT); 8B-TP2 knee [11.41,11.70] speedup (865.4→1586.1ms); experiment g3_32b has 0 vision/encoder/both pool rows in v_pool_latency; all 235b_tp8 runs have n_replicas=NULL
raw.claimed: 235B-TP8 saturation knee below 8B's; decoder scale shrinks only language pool envelope, vision pool untouched
raw.evidence: Knee comparison holds (2.5 vs 11.4-11.7 arrival speedup), but 'vision pool untouched' has zero backing — experiment g3_32b contains no vision-pool latency data at all, only language-pool K1 probes; v_grid_static_effective has 1 unrelated row
raw.fix: Either drop the vision-pool clause or add vision-pool latency data (e.g., from a grid or aggregate experiment covering 235B with encoder workers) showing encoder P50/P99 unchanged across decoder scales
